title: Mouse Cursor won’t re-appear on UAC prompt

judgment.rationale: The existing draft cursor-recovery PR explicitly addresses unavailable pointer observation across secure desktops. Route this report to that work and verify the UAC scenario there; do not claim the open PR has already fixed the installed build.
evidence: On 0.102.2933.0, idle-hide followed by UAC leaves the cursor hidden until the prompt is handled and the user desktop returns.
The report distinguishes a secure-desktop transition from an ordinary elevated application.
Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/MouseUtils/AutoHideCursor/AutoHideCursorWorker.cpp: GetCursorPosition ignores GetCursorPos failure; timer polling and WH_MOUSE_LL input drive visibility.
Read draft PR #51547 at db70f546ec94: its worker patch treats failed cursor-position reads as unavailable and restores the cursor scheme. The PR is open and unmerged, not a released fix.
judgment.recommended_action: Use the linked existing owner/fix; do not start a competing change.
